# Kieai

AI API platform providing video generation (Veo3, Kling, Runway, Luma), image generation (Flux, Nano Banana), music creation (Suno), and LLM capabilities with pay-as-you-go pricing

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/kieai/.

## Actions

- **Generate Flux Kontext Image**: Generate or edit images using the Flux Kontext model.
- **Generate GPT-4o Image**: Generate images using the GPT-4o image generation model.
- **Get Account Credits** (read-only): Retrieve the current credit balance for your KIE.AI account.
- **Add Instrumental to Vocal Track**: Add AI-generated instrumental accompaniment to an existing vocal track.
- **Add vocals to instrumental**: Add AI-generated vocals to an existing instrumental music track.
- **Create Market Task**: Create a task for unified model access through the Market API.
- **Create music video from generated audio**: Create a music video (MP4) combining generated music with visuals.
- **Execute GPT Codex**: Access GPT Codex capabilities through the KIE.AI Market API.
- **Extend Suno Music**: Extend an existing Suno music track with additional AI-generated content.
- **Extend Veo Video**: Extend an existing Veo3.1 video with additional AI-generated content.
- **Generate AI Lyrics**: Generate creative lyrics using AI.
- **Generate Aleph Video**: Generate AI video using Runway Aleph model from text prompts.
- **Generate MIDI**: Generate MIDI file from audio or music generation.
- **Generate Music Cover**: Generate a personalized cover version of a song using AI.
- **Generate Music Style**: Boost or enhance music style parameters for improved music generation.
- **Generate Sounds**: Generate sound effects or audio clips based on a text description.
- **Generate Veo Video**: Generate AI video using Google Veo3.1 model from text prompts or images.
- **Get Aleph Video Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of an Aleph video generation task.
- **Get Cover Details** (read-only): Get the status and details of a cover song generation task.
- **Get Flux Kontext Image Details** (read-only): Retrieve the status and details of a Flux Kontext image generation task.
- **Get GPT-4o Image Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of a GPT-4o image generation task.
- **Get Lyrics Details** (read-only): Retrieves the status and details of a lyrics generation task.
- **Get Market Task Details** (read-only): Retrieves the status and details of a Market API task by its task ID.
- **Get MIDI Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of a MIDI generation task.
- **Get Music Details** (read-only): Get the status and details of a Suno music generation task including generated audio URLs and metadata.
- **Get Music Video Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of a music video generation task.
- **Get Runway Video Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of a Runway video generation task.
- **Get Timestamped Lyrics** (read-only): Retrieve synchronized lyrics with timestamps for a music track.
- **Get Timestamped Lyrics Status** (read-only): Retrieve the status and results of a timestamped lyrics generation task.
- **Get Veo 1080p Video** (read-only): Retrieve the 1080p high-definition version of a completed Veo3.1 video generation.
- **Get Veo 4K Video** (read-only): Retrieve the 4K ultra-high-definition version of a completed Veo3.1 video generation.
- **Get Veo Video Details** (read-only): Retrieves details and status of a Veo3.1 video generation task.
- **Get WAV Details** (read-only): Retrieves the status and download URL for a WAV conversion task.
- **Replace Music Section**: Replace a specific section of a Suno music track with new AI-generated content.
- **Separate Vocals from Audio**: Separates vocals and instruments from an audio track using AI-powered audio source separation.
